title.narrative: Ending chronic hunger support project in Modogashe

description.narrative: Title : Ending chronic hunger support project in Modogashe Kenya Start and end dates: 01/01/2020 31/12/2021(24 months) Pcode: P8085 Summary: Addressing chronic hunger in Modogashe through; Stabilising and strengthening pastoral production systems in and around Modogashe Strengthening and diversifying household livelihoods and income in Modogashe Strengthening nutritional status through improved knowledge and practices related to health and hygiene safe water supply and improved dietary consumption in Modogashe Strengthening joint community and government initiatives to address resource-based conflict in Modogashe Location: Modogashe a border town between Garissa & Isiolo counties (majority of population living in Garissa) Beneficiaries: NA Donor: PPL GF & funding gap (RF & GF) PNSs/Partners: KRCS Kenya County Governments Budget: GF - 100 000 2019 100 000 2020 and 100 000 2021 RF - 500 000 PPL 200 000 East Africa Crisis appeal funds - Total raised so far - 1 000 000 Current situation (Jan 2020): project design and documents to be finalised in early 2020 and circulated after assessments on Q4 2019 finalised. Implementation to start in Q1 2020
